acts.title: Act I — delivered orders never invoiced (found cash)
acts.question: Quelles commandes livrées n'ont jamais été facturées ? Donne le nombre et le montant total.
acts.reference_sql: SELECT json_build_object('n', count(*), 'total', coalesce(sum(grandtotal),0)) FROM connector.t_c_order o WHERE upper(o.docstatus)='CO' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connector.t_c_invoice i WHERE i.c_order_id = o.c_order_id)

acts.title: Act II — a question through a CUSTOM column (the moat)
acts.question: TBD — written at calibration around the custom column found via 'lm source schema'
acts.reference_sql: SELECT json_build_object('n', count(*)) FROM connector.t_c_order o WHERE o.TBD_CUSTOM_COLUMN IS NOT NULL

acts.title: Act III — top-10 clients invoiced vs paid (handles the mass)
acts.question: Pour les 10 plus gros clients, montre le total facturé, le total réellement payé, et le délai moyen de paiement.
acts.reference_sql: SELECT json_build_object('n', count(*)) FROM (SELECT i.c_bpartner_id, sum(i.grandtotal) AS invoiced FROM connector.t_c_invoice i GROUP BY i.c_bpartner_id ORDER BY invoiced DESC LIMIT 10) x
